sections.Profile:
"301/Bulls Eye" is a solid-state pinball machine conversion kit released by Grand Products Inc. in May 1986. Designed to retrofit existing Bally electronic four-player cabinets (excluding 'The Six Million Dollar Man' and widebody games), the kit included a new playfield, backglass, and cabinet decals, effectively transforming older machines into a new game themed around darts.

- Manufacturer: Grand Products Inc.
- Years made: 1986
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Conversion Kit, Darts, Sports, Solid State, 1980s
